quantization.scale_definition: float32(max(abs(weight[channel])) / 127); an all-zero channel uses exact float32 1.0
quantization.division_and_rounding_reference: divide original float32 promoted to float64 by stored float32 scale promoted to float64; numpy.rint/IEEE round-to-nearest-ties-to-even
quantization.saturation: clip the rounded integer to inclusive [-127,127]; record pre-clip violations and require zero for this checkpoint
quantization.zero_handling: exact zero maps to integer zero; nonzero values may quantize to zero and are counted per channel
quantization.scale_fixed_point_candidate: unsigned UQ0.31 little-endian uint32, round-to-nearest-ties-to-even and saturate to [0,2^32-1]
quantization.weight_payload_layout: I_KY_KX_O, C-order little-endian signed int8; O is contiguous and divisible into eight 96-lane vectors
quantization.accumulator_init: signed int32 zero for every output channel because all four Conv2d modules are bias-free
quantization.runtime_integer_product: signed support/delta polarity times signed int8 weight

accumulator_bounds.universal_local_or_signed_motion_bound: sum over 768*3*3 terms of abs(qweight); dense INT8 envelope is 768*9*127=877824
accumulator_bounds.overflow_policy: fail if any checkpoint per-channel sum(abs(qweight)) does not fit the emitted signed-width lower bound

m251_layout_bridge.reason: The candidate payload makes every 96-output vector contiguous, but the current residency envelope cannot retain a complete 96-output-channel layer tile. M241r2 must still close variable-latency macro response, loader epoch, SRAM bases, ports, and cycle timing.

local_numeric_audit.reference: raw float32 Conv2d versus dequantized-per-channel-weight float32 Conv2d, stride1/pad1/dilation1, bias absent
local_numeric_audit.scope: four bottleneck raw convolution outputs only

value_mask_multicast_audit.source_term_vector: for every (input_channel,kernel_y,kernel_x), the 768 signed INT8 weights over output_channel
value_mask_multicast_audit.command_definition: one nonzero signed INT8 value plus one exact destination bit mask for each distinct nonzero value in a block
value_mask_multicast_audit.zero_weight_rule: zero destinations emit no product command and remain zero in every value mask
value_mask_multicast_audit.scope: weight broadcast and fetch potential only
value_mask_multicast_audit.not_admitted: accumulator-cycle reduction, bank-feasible issue rate, SRAM compression, system speedup, or M42 architecture admission
